items.sentence: The tree’s thick outer bark protected its trunk from insects and harsh weather.
When the doorbell rang, the small dog barked twice, making two short, sharp sounds instead of a long call.
Firefighters rescued the climber by lifting the fallen tree off his leg and carrying him to safety.
The alarm detected a tiny gas leak and began ringing before anyone could smell the gas.
The lab found contamination in the well water: bacteria had entered through a crack, so residents were told not to drink it.
The nurse isolated the patient in a separate room until tests showed he was no longer contagious, keeping him away from others.
She was cautious while crossing the old bridge, testing each board first because some were loose.
Before opening the damaged wall, the builder estimated the repair cost at about $800 because the exact total was still unknown.
